description: PlayerActivity.kt defines an Android activity that embeds an ExoPlayer instance for media playback, handling UI controls, immersive fullscreen mode, and media loading based on intent extras.

classes.name: PlayerActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a video player with custom controls, supporting immersive full-screen mode and media playback via ExoPlayer.

methods.name: PlayerActivity.newIntent
methods.description: Creates a new intent to launch PlayerActivity with media URL, title, and optional poster.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI, reads intent extras, and sets up the player view and controls.

methods.name: initializePlayer
methods.description: Builds and prepares the ExoPlayer instance to stream media from the URL.

methods.name: enterImmersiveMode
methods.description: Enables full-screen immersive mode, hiding system UI elements.

methods.name: wireControllerButtons
methods.description: Binds click listeners to custom control buttons.

methods.name: attachControllerListenersIfPresent
methods.description: Finds control buttons within the player view and assigns actions.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Initializes the player if appropriate based on SDK level.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Re-enters immersive mode and initializes the player if needed.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Releases the player on pause for SDK < 24.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Releases the player on stop for SDK >= 24.

methods.name: onBackPressed
methods.description: Releases the player and performs back navigation with fade transition.
